entities.name: Shirei
entities.description: A kami of Kamigawa active during the Kami War, kami of the abandoned battlefield Shizo and a shepherd of the dead.

entities.name: Shizo
entities.description: The disgraced and abandoned battlefield of which Shirei is kami.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Shirei was active.

relations.quote: Shirei is the kami of the disgraced and abandoned battlefield called Shizo
